question: How does fasting by day affect the inevitability of death from aging?
premises: Death from aging is a natural end
This practice leads beyond that death
inference: Through fasting by day, one will overcome death caused by aging.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is idiomatic; interpreted as going beyond or overcoming death
plain_english: By fasting during the day, one will overcome death from old age.
